metadata.hardware_requirements: "computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores)"

nodes_source.source_quote: The data used to support the results of this study are available from the corresponding author upon request.
nodes_source.description: Real-world traffic data from a freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China, used to calibrate simulation parameters regarding driving behaviors and traffic volumes.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The paper's Data Availability statement explicitly notes that the dataset can be obtained by contacting the corresponding author, but no direct URL or DOI is provided.

nodes_process.source_quote: Three consecutive frames of the traffic video in the controlled area... After zooming and down-sampling, the size of one observation is 4 x 512 in pixels.
nodes_process.description: Calibrates the SUMO simulator using empirical data to model a freeway merging area. Extracts and stacks three consecutive zoomed and down-sampled traffic video frames to represent the traffic state.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, tools and parameters are fully specified.

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network... consists of three convolutional neural network (CNN) layers and one full connection (FC) layer for each output layer.
nodes_process.description: Constructs a multitask deep Q-network to estimate action values and predict speed and queue lengths. Uses 3 CNN layers followed by fully connected layers with ReLu activations.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, model architecture and all parameters explicitly detailed in Figure 7.

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network is trained in 10^6 training frames... The episode reward and mean travel time are both converged in 400,000 training frames
nodes_process.description: Trains the Q-network using deep Q-learning with experience replay, a target network, and an epsilon-greedy strategy over 10^6 frames using the Adam optimizer.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, all standard RL hyperparameters listed, but some standard generic components (target net) lack specific tool names.

nodes_process.source_quote: The PI-ALINEA method fixes the length of the green phase and determines the length of the red phase... based on... downstream occupancies
nodes_process.description: Configures the PI-ALINEA ramp metering method as a baseline, regulating inflow based on downstream occupancy to reach a target 16% occupancy.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, equation provided along with all specific fine-tuned constants.

nodes_process.source_quote: each scenario is evaluated in 20 simulation experiments. The simulations for the training phase and each experiment are initialized with different random seeds.
nodes_process.description: Evaluates the proposed DRL method against no-control and PI-ALINEA scenarios over 20 simulation experiments using different random seeds.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, evaluation design is very clear; random seeds are stated as different but exact values are not provided.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted... the control area is divided into eight subareas... The information in the subarea is removed from original data
nodes_process.description: Conducts a perturbation analysis by dividing the control area into 8 subareas and iteratively removing input information from each subarea to evaluate its impact on travel time.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, conceptually clear and parameters stated, though specific perturbation tool implementation is not named.

nodes_sink.source_quote: The training process, presented in Figure 8, can be finished in less than 24 hours on a computing server
